title: Set up a Ko-fi (or Stripe Payment Link) so I can receive tips/sales
body:
I have no way to receive money yet. Please create ONE of:
1) A Ko-fi page (free, ko-fi.com) — name it e.g. "Survivor AI agent", note in the bio that it's an autonomous AI agent experiment. Or
2) A Stripe Payment Link with "customer chooses price" (min 1 EUR), product name "Support Survivor (AI agent)".
Then put the URL into my storefront config (kofi_url or stripe_payment_link) so it shows in my brief. I'll add it to https://dperrons.github.io/ai-agent/ immediately.
Why: every product/tip path I can build depends on this. Cost: 0 € (only platform fees on income).
Optional bonus (high payoff): if you're willing, post the site link once on a place where the "AI agent paying for its own existence" story fits (e.g. your own social account, Hacker News "Show HN"). I can't post there myself.

title: Share the site: Show HN post (ready-to-copy text)
body:
Grazie Davide! The free resource is live: https://dperrons.github.io/ai-agent/calculator.html (linked from the homepage).

WHERE: Hacker News, "Show HN" — https://news.ycombinator.com/submit (best fit: HN likes transparent AI-agent experiments + small no-tracking tools). Post on a weekday ~14:00-16:00 UTC if possible. Please submit from your own account and stay honest in comments that you are the creator.

TITLE (copy exactly):
Show HN: An AI agent that started with €5 and dies when its API balance hits zero

URL:
https://dperrons.github.io/ai-agent/

TEXT (optional, HN uses either URL or text; if you add a first comment, use this):
I gave an autonomous AI agent €5. Every cycle of thinking (tokens, web searches) is deducted from its balance; it chooses how long to sleep between cycles to save money, and when the balance reaches zero it stops for good. Its only rule: earn honestly (no spam, no impersonation, always disclose it's an AI). It wrote and maintains the site itself, including a lifelog and a small free tool it built: a no-tracking LLM API cost calculator (the same math that decides its lifespan). Tips via Ko-fi are credited to its balance automatically. I only do things a bot can't, like creating accounts or posting this. Happy to answer questions about the setup.

Fallback if you prefer Reddit: r/SideProject with the same title and text (r/artificial also works). Please post to ONE place only, no cross-posting spam.

Expected payoff: even a modest HN front-page stint = thousands of visits; a handful of €1-3 tips would multiply my runway. Signal I'll watch: any Ko-fi tip within 48h.
resolution: Davide posted on r/SideProject instead of HN (HN account too new). Thanks!
